dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent in Beledweyne City, Beledweyne District, Hiraan Region, Somalia, 12 November 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20231105SOM** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters in Beledweyne City, Beledweyne District, Hiraan Region, Somalia, 12 November 2023 at 07:32 UTC. Within the analysed area of about 50 km2 about 14 km2 of land appear to be flooded. Furthermore, within the analysed area about 22,000 buildings are identified as potentially affected by the floods. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
